item.description:
Release v5.12.0

Changes since v5.11.1

  • docs(BookletMaker): document mobile and multiplatform plans
  • docs(KernelHosting): add README
  • feat: enhance API key management in provider access failed view
  • feat(AppIconDesignerPlugin): add dual-scope storage and LLM icon review
  • feat(BookletMakerPlugin): finish cross-platform adaptation
  • feat(BookletMakerPlugin): localize mobile UI and add zh-Hant translations
  • feat(BookletMakerPlugin): make PDF page rendering cross-platform
  • feat(BookletMakerPlugin): support export cancellation and richer progress UI
  • feat(ConversationInputPlugin): add native placeholder support for chat input
  • feat(FactoryLumi): set initialContainerID to chat-panel plugin
  • feat(foundation): add iOS platform support
  • feat(iOS): add BookletMaker-iOS canary target
  • feat(iOS): add FactoryCoreMobile host engine; widen WorkspacePlugin
  • feat(iOS): add native BookletMaker mobile workspace
  • feat(iOS): real BookletMaker-iOS app (kernel boot + PDF import/export)
  • feat(LocalizationKit): fall back across Chinese script variants
  • feat(MessageListPlugin): smart empty state with API key setup and suggestions
  • feat(OnboardingPlugin): add multi-step onboarding with AI setup and features tour
  • fix(BookletMaker-iOS): declare supported localizations in app plist
  • refactor(BookletMaker): merge app targets across platforms
